tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Builds a link-in-bio page on lnx.net from the user's name, links, socials and bio, and returns a claim_url. The user opens it, sees the finished page, can edit it, and publishes it to lnx.net/<username> with an LNX account. Nothing goes public until they do.

tools.name: check_username
tools.description: Checks whether lnx.net/<username> is available, and suggests alternatives if not.
